items.title: 8.8 Equilibrium constant aur equilibrium ki position (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8, printed pages 173-174.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ki position ka matlab hai equilibrium mixture mein products aur reactants ki ek doosre ke muqable miqdar (relative amounts).

1864 mein Norway ke chemists C. Guldberg (1836–1902) aur P. Waage (1833–1900) ne equilibrium par bohat si reactions ki composition (banawat) dhyan se napi. Unhon ne dekha ke har reversible reaction mein products ki equilibrium concentrations ka hasil-e-zarb (product, yani aapas mein multiply), har ek apne coefficient ki power ke saath, jab reactants ki concentrations ke aise hi hasil-e-zarb se divide kiya jaye, to diye gaye halaat mein jawab hamesha ek constant aata hai.
Yahan A aur B reactants, C aur D products, aur a, b, c, d balanced equation ke stoichiometric coefficients (equation mein har cheez ke aage likhe numbers) hain.

Chemical reaction ki rate reactants ke active masses ke seedha mutanasib (directly proportional) hoti hai, har ek balanced equation ke coefficient ki power ke saath. Active mass ka matlab molar concentration hai, jo mol dm⁻³ mein likhi jati hai aur square brackets [ ] se dikhai jati hai.
Law of mass action ke mutabiq:
‘kf’ forward rate constant hai, yani tanasub (proportionality) ka constant.
‘kr’ reverse rate constant hai, yeh bhi proportionality ka constant.
Equilibrium par forward aur reverse rates barabar hoti hain, is liye:
Baen (left) taraf do rate constants ki nisbat (ratio) hai, jo khud ek naya constant deti hai; ise equilibrium constant (Kc) kehte hain.
Is equation ko equilibrium constant expression kehte hain.
jahan a, b, c aur d balanced equation ke coefficients hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kc likhne ka tareeqa: products oopar (numerator), reactants neeche (denominator), aur har concentration par us ka coefficient power ban kar lagta hai. Misal: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ ke liye Kc = [NH₃]² / [N₂][H₂]³.

items: Equilibrium ki position: products aur reactants ki relative miqdar.
Guldberg aur Waage (1864): aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD ke liye Kc = [C]ᶜ[D]ᵈ / [A]ᵃ[B]ᵇ ek diye gaye temperature par constant hai.
Law of mass action: equilibrium par kf[A][B] = kr[C][D], is liye Kc = kf / kr = [C][D] / [A][B].
